# The Non-Obvious Book Awards

> An annual awards program curating the best non-fiction books of the year, founded in 2014 by 3-time WSJ bestselling author Rohit Bhargava and the Non-Obvious Company. No entry categories, no fees. Each year: 5 winners (most important, original, entertaining, useful, shareable), a 15-book shortlist, and a ~100-book longlist of the best non-fiction and business books of the year.

Key facts:
- The 2023 awards were presented with Inc. magazine as the Inc. Non-Obvious Book Awards.
- Entries for the 2026 awards are open until October 31, 2026 (no fee; two print copies required).
- Winners are announced live every December.
